historical_record.description: The property held a two-story mixed use building with a detached garage.

The City Planning Commission approved conditional use to install a wireless telecommunication facility of two antennas, one GPS antenna, and five equipment cabinets within the detached garage of a two-story mixed use building, after an intent to disapprove failed.
